$comment: P2-B/P2-C regression ratchet, recorded from a measurement and never hand-tuned. `kernel_to_feature_file_edges` is the number workbook section 16 must drive to ZERO ('foundation -> building implementation edges = 0'); until it is zero this artifact is the floor that stops it silently growing back. Lowering a value here is the whole point of the migration and is done in the same commit that lowers it; raising one requires a recorded reason, because the alternative reading of a rise is a new inversion.
ownership_model: config/capability-modules.json -- the OWNERSHIP MAP, not the manifests
why_the_model_is_named: The manifests declare 25 module paths and therefore see 3 capability edges; the ownership map owns 596 files (plus 2 composition-root files) and sees 801 cross-capability file edges. Every number below is meaningless without saying which model produced it, and the legacy `architecture:ratchet` -- which reads the manifests -- cannot see any of these edges at all. That is why this ratchet exists beside it rather than inside it.
measured_cycles_by: node scripts/phase2-cycles.cjs (read by this ratchet, not recomputed here)
reason: Lowered four times. From 82 to 73 by the provider closure extraction (CC-029), from 73 to 66 by the first ROAD declarations (CC-038) and from 66 to 62 by the second (CC-040). From 62 to 61 by INVERTING the last kernel -> building edge that held a mutual pair: electron/bootstrap/providers.ts imported the RuntimeRegistry TYPE from electron/commander/runtime-registry.ts purely to declare a parameter it receives, so the consumer now declares the minimal shape it needs (RuntimeRegistrar) and the implementation satisfies it structurally. That single type import was the whole of providers -> tenx, and with its reverse (tenx -> providers, 27 edges) it formed the mutual pair providers <-> tenx; the pair count falls 34 -> 33, the pair list 23 -> 22, and the RAW edge total 801 -> 800 because a repair DELETES an edge rather than moving it. The largest SCC stays at 20: the knot is held by other edges, and this entry claims only what it repaired. The total is now recorded as a CEILING rather than a floor (CC-046) for exactly that reason. From 61 to 60, pairs 22 -> 21 and mutual pairs 33 -> 32 by the ATOMIC attachments namespace-ownership migration (CC-065): the `attachments` namespace moved from the `persistence` manifest to the capability that implements its store, the store is now built on that capability's own boot path instead of inside `bootstrap/persistence.ts`, and `electron/input/attachment-upload.ts` declares the two-list snapshot shape it actually reads instead of importing the kernel's `StateStore` type. The pair `persistence <-> attachments` was one edge each way and BOTH are gone: the raw total 800 -> 798 and `capability_edges` 203 -> 201 fell by exactly the two edges removed, and a per-edge diff of the two trees' edge sets shows 2 removed and 0 added -- nothing was relocated into the composition root this time (edgesFromCompositionRoot stays 97). `largest_scc_size` stays 20: the knot is held by other edges. From 60 to 59, pairs 21 -> 20 and mutual pairs 32 -> 31 by the SAME repair applied to `identity` (CC-066): the `session-lifecycle` namespace moved from the `persistence` manifest to the capability that implements its store, a new boot module `electron/bootstrap/identity.ts` builds it from a `dataRoot` the composition root passes in, and `electron/main.ts` stopped importing `electron/identity/` at all by deriving its binding's type from that module's own service -- so the `persistence <-> identity` pair lost BOTH of its one-edge directions. The raw total 798 -> 796 and `capability_edges` 201 -> 199 fell by exactly the two edges removed; `edgesFromCompositionRoot` also fell 97 -> 96, which is the type import `main.ts` no longer needs. This is a CLASS M dependency under the successor workbook's classification and it is recorded as such: the OTHER half of `identity` is a real runtime use of `electron/commander/durable-json`, which is a declared ROAD, so that edge is verified and left alone rather than moved, and the road totals (`road_files` 6, `edges_to_roads` 75) are unchanged. `largest_scc_size` stays 20 again. FROM 60 TO 59, PAIRS 21 -> 20 AND MUTUAL PAIRS 32 -> 31 by the SAME repair applied to identity (CC-066): the session-lifecycle namespace moved from the persistence manifest to the capability that implements its store, so  ootstrap/persistence.ts no longer imports SessionLifecycleLedger and no longer forwards it -- the persistence <-> identity pair lost its kernel -> feature direction, and main.ts no longer imports electron/identity/ to NAME the type it holds, which is the other direction. The RAW totals fall with them: total 798 -> 797 and capability_edges 201 -> 200. NO NEW BOOT MODULE was added, and that is a recorded constraint rather than a preference: 	ests/unit/city/architecture-hosted-shadow.test.ts requires config/architecture-baseline.json to stay byte-identical to the Phase 1B-A freeze commit, and a new boot module raises that file bootModuleCount, so the construction was relocated with one fewer site instead of gaining a module. files_owned stays 598 for the same reason -- no file was added or hidden. This is a CLASS M dependency and the OTHER half is left alone: identity -> <road> (durable-json) is a real runtime use of a shared primitive, road_files 6 and edges_to_roads 75 are unchanged, so nothing was moved into the road class to make a number fall. largest_scc_size stays 20. FROM 59 TO 58 and pairs 20 -> 19 by the SAME repair applied to `node` (CC-067): the `node-registry` namespace moved from the `persistence` manifest to the capability that implements it, so `bootstrap/persistence.ts` no longer imports NodeCapabilityRegistry and no longer forwards it -- the kernel -> feature edge is DELETED. This pair had NO REVERSE EDGE, so unlike `attachments` and `identity` nothing had to be traded and nothing had to be verified-and-left-alone: this is the cleanest instance of the repair. Raw total 797 -> 796 and capability_edges 200 -> 199 fall with it. THE LARGEST SCC FELL 20 -> 19, the first movement in that metric, because the 20-node knot contained `node` and deleting the only edge that reached it from `persistence` removed it from the strongly connected component -- progress in S3 and S4 at the same time, which section 17's mutual pairs and section 15.7's ratchet both measure. No new boot module was added (the frozen architecture baseline forbids one, see CC-066). files_owned stays 598; the SCANNED file count is 612 rather than 613 because a file moved between capabilities and the declared-namespace floor of 32 is unchanged, so nothing was hidden from the scanner. FROM 58 TO 57 and pairs 19 -> 18 by the SAME repair applied to `experience` (CC-068): the `experience` namespace moved from the `persistence` manifest to the capability that implements it, so `bootstrap/persistence.ts` no longer imports ExperienceStore and no longer forwards it. The pair had NO REVERSE EDGE, like `node`, so the kernel -> feature edge is deleted outright. THE RAW TOTAL DID NOT FALL THIS TIME and that is the honest reading rather than a defect: this store's path is WORKSPACE-SCOPED, so the composition root must resolve the active workspace root and construct it, which DELETES one kernel -> feature edge and ADDS one composition-root -> feature edge -- `edgesFromCompositionRoot` rises 97 -> 98 while the total stays 796. A programme reporting only the raw total would see no change at all, and a programme reporting only kernel -> feature would miss that the construction moved to the root. Both numbers are therefore recorded, and `files_owned` stays 598. This is the third distinct price of the same repair, after CC-065 (two edges deleted, raw fell 2), CC-066 (two deleted and one added, raw fell 1) and CC-067 (one deleted, raw fell 1). The signature of a genuine ownership migration is always the same: the DELETION appears in kernel -> feature, and the raw total tells you whether the construction moved.

anti_gaming.files_owned_is_a_floor: A drop in edges that comes from a drop in SCANNED FILES is not progress. `files_owned` is asserted to stay at or above its recorded value, so a file cannot be removed from the scanner -- or handed to the composition-root class to make it invisible -- to make the migration look finished.
anti_gaming.capabilities_with_kinds_is_pinned: `kernel` is read from the manifests' `kind` field, so a kernel that lost its kind would silently stop being counted. The kind count is pinned so that cannot happen quietly.
anti_gaming.the_composition_root_must_stay_visible: The composition root is present and its edges are counted separately. If it were removed from the map instead of re-attributed, `files_owned` would fall; if it were re-attributed back to `runtime`, `kernel_to_feature_file_edges` would jump by about 72.
anti_gaming.roads_must_stay_visible_and_leafless: A road declaration MOVES edges out of a building's column without deleting anything, so both of its numbers are FLOORS: `road_files` (a declared road cannot be un-declared to push its edges back) and `edges_to_roads` (the moved edges are published on their own line precisely so they cannot vanish). The ratchet also fails if ANY edge leaves a road, because a road that imports another capability is not a road at all -- it is a building dependency, and attributing it to the road class would hide that edge (ledger CC-030's refutation).
anti_gaming.the_cycle_graph_has_floors: `largest_scc_size` is a CEILING -- section 17's target is 0 and a large component does not split from pairwise repairs -- but the GRAPH it is computed over has FLOORS (`capability_nodes`, `capability_edges`). Shrinking the largest component by losing an edge from the measurement is the same fraud as shrinking the inversion count by scanning fewer files, and it would be invisible from the component size alone. `capability_edges` is a PAIR count, so a road declaration can legitimately reduce it -- two pairs collapse into one when a capability's only edge to another capability was onto a road -- which is why the RAW total (`total_cross_capability_file_edges`) is floored as well, and it is the stronger anchor of the two: a declaration MOVES an edge and must leave the total untouched, so a fall there means edges were actually lost.
anti_gaming.the_two_cycle_count_is_measured_twice: `mutual_capability_pairs` is asserted from BOTH the inventory's pair rollup and the cycle instrument's own edge list. If the two instruments ever disagree, both problems fire: a number nobody can reproduce is worse than a number that is wrong.
